purpose: Teach: 公債/渡航/出国/通院/含有/取り扱っ/照会/婚姻

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、公債を活用して資金を調達された
lines.en: Father used government bonds to raise capital.
lines.style: Measured, grounded recollection. Opens with quiet certainty. Steady pace, no rush. The tone of someone sharing a fact that still matters to them.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは海外渡航で見聞を広められた
lines.en: Yes. Father broadened his horizons through international travel.
lines.style: Formal acknowledgment, but with warmth beneath. Slight emphasis on 'broadened'—recognition of the impact. Clear, respectful cadence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社員の出国時に必ずお見送りされた
lines.en: Father always saw our staff off when they traveled abroad.
lines.style: Softer now, almost wistful. Slower pace on the second half. A small smile in the voice—admiration for a gesture others might have missed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員の通院に理解があった
lines.en: Yes. Father was deeply understanding about staff needing time for medical appointments.
lines.style: Quiet reflection. Slight pause before speaking. The tone of someone understanding the weight of what that meant—the small humanity of it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、商品の含有成分にこだわられた
lines.en: Father was exacting about the ingredients that went into our products.
lines.style: Steady appreciation. Light emphasis on 'exacting.' The speaker is remembering precision as care. No hurry in the delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは機密情報を厳しく取り扱っておられた
lines.en: Yes. Father handled confidential information with absolute strictness.
lines.style: Measured, grave. A small pause before 'absolute.' The respect is in the certainty. Not defensive—simply stating what was.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、お客様の照会には自ら答えられた
lines.en: Father answered customer inquiries himself, whenever he could.
lines.style: Voice softens further. Slight trailing emphasis on 'himself'—the choice to be present matters. Slower, with space between the ideas.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員の婚姻を心からお祝いされた
lines.en: Yes. Father celebrated our staff's marriages with genuine joy.
lines.style: Quiet warmth closing the reflection. Gentle emphasis on 'genuine.' A slight upward inflection—the memory itself is a gift. Graceful closing cadence.
